name: Reo Nakamura
source:
Reo is the main protagonist of Pixel Happy Game Girls, he is a childhood friend of Masako, and is appointed by her to be the main programmer of Robotopia.

He is a bit snarky towards the other girls on the team, but he ultimately has a good heart and does his best to help out.
